name: Home side at the pinned home-court value
signal: bet the home club whenever the pinned home-court value, converted from the measured home-win rate, is greater than zero
universe: every game of the official slate for the round window, one pick per game
settlement_rule: MONEYLINE: the pick wins if the side named wins the game. The result is read from the official final score of that game's own page; a game with no verified final is void, not a loss
stake_rule: 1 unit, capped at 5% of the bankroll, no martingale, no re-stake after settlement
luck_policy: refused for any club whose luck z-score is outside +/-2, because a home-side pick on a club winning on luck rather than play is not a skill edge
author: arena/2ecbccfd-nba3
